item.title: Correction · Five88 (Mission Bay South Block 7 West): The record now says 200 affordable apartments as SocketSite reported them (not '198 plus a manager's unit') and treats SocketSite's January 2015 piece as a forecast of an April 2015 groundbreaking, not a report that it happened; the 'under construction' milestone was removed. Entries that said Blue Bottle Coffee was announced, and that Proper Foods and Bank of America opened, were reworded to say only that a sign permit exists. Entries about the teller-line, address-correction, excavation and sliding-door permits now say what the DBI permit records show (issued or completed, and which permit). The Assessor details now reflect the 2023-2025 rolls (year built 2017, 208 units), the NAIP aerial image credit names the Farm Production and Conservation Business Center, and the Wikimedia photo credit no longer names an author or a flight that the file page does not state.

item.title: Correction · Five88 (Mission Bay South Block 7 West): Two tenant entries were dropped as duplicates, not errors. Permits 201911016171 (two illuminated wall signs) and 201911016173 (one illuminated wall sign) were the same signage buildout for the same Bank of America branch at 588 Mission Bay Blvd North, filed minutes apart on 2019-11-01 and both issued 2019-11-12; the more specific entry was kept. Likewise permits 202205194649 (sign A) and 202205194650 (sign B) were the same Proper Food(s) signage buildout at the same address, filed 12 minutes apart on 2022-09-01; the 'Proper Foods' entry (open, dated) was kept and the 'Proper Food' entry (announced, undated) dropped, rather than show the same tenant twice under two spellings and two statuses. Permits are read one at a time, with no check for duplicates across permits, so this is a known gap rather than a one-off mistake.
item.description: Two tenant entries were dropped as duplicates, not errors. Permits 201911016171 (two illuminated wall signs) and 201911016173 (one illuminated wall sign) were the same signage buildout for the same Bank of America branch at 588 Mission Bay Blvd North, filed minutes apart on 2019-11-01 and both issued 2019-11-12; the more specific entry was kept. Likewise permits 202205194649 (sign A) and 202205194650 (sign B) were the same Proper Food(s) signage buildout at the same address, filed 12 minutes apart on 2022-09-01; the 'Proper Foods' entry (open, dated) was kept and the 'Proper Food' entry (announced, undated) dropped, rather than show the same tenant twice under two spellings and two statuses. Permits are read one at a time, with no check for duplicates across permits, so this is a known gap rather than a one-off mistake. Source: SF Department of Building Inspection, permits 201911016171, 201911016173, 202205194649 and 202205194650 (https://dbiweb02.sfgov.org/).
